summary: The whole company of saints is celebrated, from the apostles to those known only to God. Their lives remind us that every faithful witness contributes to the glory of the Church.
antiphon_text: Let us remember All Saints as a faithful witness to the love and mercy of Christ.
prayer_text: Lord God, through the life of All Saints, strengthen us to follow your path with courage and charity. Grant us the grace to bear faithful witness in our own time. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
